# Money Flow Index

*Volume weighted RSI on the typical price.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Money Flow Index** under **Oscillators**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `14` |
| Source | source | `"hlc3"` |
| Color | color | `"#7E57C2"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/mfi.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Money Flow Index", shortTitle: "MFI", overlay: false, precision: 2 });
const length = input.int("Length", 14, { min: 1 });
plot(ta.mfi(input.source("Source", "hlc3"), length), { title: "MF", color: input.color("Color", "#7E57C2", { group: "Style" }) });
hline(80, { title: "Overbought", color: "#787B86", style: "dashed" });
hline(50, { title: "Middle band", color: "rgba(120,123,134,0.5)", style: "dotted" });
hline(20, { title: "Oversold", color: "#787B86", style: "dashed" });
fill(80, 20, { title: "Background", color: "rgba(126,87,194,0.1)" });
```
